cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a rule requires drafts to be put online for public comment.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-03: the telecoms regulator's March 2024 final report sets out the inputs received on its draft QoS Regulations and its decision on each. The draft went online in 2021, before the window, but the later answer carries the earlier one; nothing says a rule requires drafts online.
